what: While the hero scrolls down by 1.2× the window width (scrub 1), the giant wordmark exits 150% of its own width to the left, the two lines of text below go 250% left and 200% right, and the four scattered square photos go up 200% of their own height, emptying the screen. Each piece gets .5s power1.out (the original timeline default) tied to the scroll, and from the second one on the photos start .02 later.

options.[data-fx-part=part]: Piece that drops out — data-x · data-y (% of its own size), data-at (timeline position, default 0), narrow-screen values data-x-sp · data-y-sp
options.span: End — when scrolled down by window width × span, default 1.2 (1 for the work list)
options.narrow: Width (px) below which data-*-sp is used, default 640
options.dur: Tween length per piece (ratio within the timeline), default .5

use: Wordmark
